name: cpig-78-export-3mf
description: 78 Export Implicit 3MF (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Export)

setup.vlmDescription: A light-blue sphere mesh visible in the viewport (the field being exported), with Grasshopper panels showing Success=True and a file path.
setup.whatItDoes: Exports a CPig field as a 3MF Volumetric file. LIBFIVE fields export as lossless function graphs; VDB/PROCEDURAL fields voxel-bake (lossy at VoxelRes). No visual output — verify via Success/Path panels.
setup.whatYouShouldSee: No visual geometry from the export itself. The revised test meshes the input sphere for Custom Preview. Success=True, Path=file path.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
